description: Same club: the dancer performs a floor routine on a pink cloth spread over the plywood floor, red fabric pooled at right, while the front row leans in — one soldier reaches toward her with a bill or note in hand. The seated man at upper left wears a SHOULDER SLEEVE INSIGNIA (patch) in red/gold tones on his left shoulder — one of the few clear SSI sightings in the survey and a MAGNIFICATION PRIORITY for unit identification. Another soldier holds a camera and flash in his lap; a blond head (back of head, foreground right) watches — possibly Larry. Gibson amplifier, drum kit, guitars, and a small tan amp complete the stage corner.
